scenario: Show every available plugin and which are installed, then search for plugins matching 'review'.
rubric: Runs Get-Plugin.ps1 for the full available-plus-installed listing and Find-Plugin.ps1 for the search.
Invokes the scripts directly with -RepoRoot . and relies on the registry-path fallback instead of assuming a root registry.json.
Presents name, version, and installed/modified/outdated status and mutates nothing.
